# 佛說三摩竭經

**ID:** T0129
**Volume:** T02
**Category:** 阿含部類
**Original Category:** 阿含部
**Byline:** 吳 竺律炎譯
**Dynasty:** 吳
**Date:** 230
**Juans:** 1

## Contributors
- 竺律炎 (A000764)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Three-Kingdoms Wú translation of an alternative recension of the *Sumāgadhaavadāna*, parallel to T128a / T128b. The Chinese title 三摩竭 *Sānmójié* is a phonetic transcription of *Sumāgadha* (an alternative form of Sumati's name in some recensions of the legend).

**Abstract**

[竺律炎](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E5%BE%8B%E7%82%8E) Zhú Lǜyàn (also written 竺將炎, 竺持炎; alternates 律炎, 炎) was a third-century Indian monk active at the Wú court at Wǔchāng 武昌. He arrived in Huángwǔ 黃武 3 (224 CE) with the Indic-language master [維祇難](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%B6%AD%E7%A5%87%E9%9B%A3) Wéizhǐnán, bringing the Sanskrit text of the *Dhammapada* (which they translated as the *Tánbō jīng* 曇鉢經, later transmitted as the *Fǎjù jīng* 法句經 ([KR6b0067](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6b/KR6b0067))). After Wéizhǐnán's death he worked in Huánglóng 2 (234) with [Zhī Qiān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E8%AC%99) on the *Módēngjiā jīng* 摩登伽經 ([KR6j0531](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0531), *Mātaṅga-sūtra*) and, with Zhī Yuè 支越 (probably another name for Zhī Qiān), on the *Fóyī jīng* 佛醫經 ([KR6i0497](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0497)). T131 is one of his independent translations. The defensible bracket 224–253 (his Wú period of activity) is recorded in the frontmatter.
